title: Likelihood of getting a job after graduating with a CS degree?

comments: Network as much as you can.

title: Just landed my first SWE offer after 200 applications!
body: Finally got an offer after months of grinding. Don't give up everyone!

body: I don't know how much more of this I can take. Feeling completely defeated.

comments: Do your research on market rates first.

title: Market is finally picking up, got 3 interviews this week
body: After months of silence, suddenly getting calls. Maybe things are turning around.

title: Should I take a $70k offer or keep waiting?
body: It's below market but I've been unemployed for 8 months. Torn on what to do.
comments: 8 months is a long time, take it.

title: AI is making entry level jobs disappear, this is terrifying
body: Every company I talk to says they're using AI to replace junior devs.
comments: The market has shifted, adapt or struggle.

title: Finally got a job! 10 months of searching but it happened
body: Don't give up. It's brutal out there but it does happen eventually.
comments: This is what I needed to hear today.

title: Laid off again. Second time in two years.
body: I don't know what to do anymore. This industry feels impossible.
comments: So sorry, this market is brutal.

title: How important is leetcode really?
body: I've been grinding for 3 months and still bombing interviews. Is it worth it?

title: Best resources for learning Python?

comments: Automate the Boring Stuff is great.

title: Finally understood recursion today, feeling great!
body: It clicked after weeks of confusion. Loving this journey.

title: Is it too late to start programming at 25?
body: Feeling behind everyone who started young.

body: I don't think I'm cut out for this. Nothing makes sense.

body: Took 3 months but I finally have something to show. So proud of this.

Stick with it, it clicks eventually.

title: Passed my first technical interview!
body: Never thought I'd get here. Hard work pays off.

title: Feeling completely overwhelmed by how much there is to learn
body: Every time I learn one thing there are ten more things I don't know.
comments: That feeling never goes away honestly.
Focus on one thing at a time.

body: Trying to decide the best path into the industry.

title: Just got my first freelance client, couldn't be happier
body: Starting small but this feels like a huge win.
comments: First one is always the hardest to get.

title: How long did it take you to feel confident as a developer?
body: Been coding for a year and still feel like I know nothing.
comments: Years, honestly. But it gets better.

title: Open source contribution changed everything for me
body: My skills have grown more in 2 months of OSS than a year of tutorials.

title: Is computer science a good major right now?
body: Everyone is saying the market is terrible. Should I switch?
comments: It's tough but still worth it long term.

title: Got accepted into my dream CS program!
body: So excited to start this fall. Any advice for incoming freshmen?

body: The workload is insane and I'm not sure I'll find a job after.

body: I studied so hard and still failed. Maybe I'm just not smart enough for this.
comments: Algorithms is brutal, you're not alone.

title: Landed a summer internship at a mid size startup!

body: Heard data science has better job prospects right now. Thoughts?
comments: Data science is also competitive now.

title: Professor failed half the class on the final. Is this normal?
body: Nobody passed with above a 70. The curve saved most of us but barely.
comments: That sounds like a bad professor.
Unfortunately common in weed out courses.

title: Senior year and finally feeling confident in my skills
body: Took a long time but it all started clicking this semester.
comments: Senior year is when it all comes together.

body: Half the companies that signed up didn't show. The ones that did weren't hiring.
comments: The market is really showing everywhere.

body: Just goes to show what a good portfolio project can do.

body: Vibe coding is already putting junior devs out of work.

body: 3 days in office starting next month. Pretty frustrated about it.

body: I don't even know how to feel about this.

body: My tech lead tears apart every PR I submit in front of the whole team.

body: I just vibe code all day, ask me anything.

body: Started contributing 3 months ago and my skills have skyrocketed.
comments: Looks great on a resume too.

body: Two years in and the loneliness is real.

title: Rust is incredible and I don't understand why everyone avoids it
body: Yes the learning curve is steep but the payoff is worth it.

body: Half the comments are style opinions that don't matter.

body: Never expected this kind of response. Feels amazing.

body: Just inherited a codebase with zero documentation and no tests.

body: Not replacing me, just making me faster. It's a great tool.
